04 / BEHIND THE DESIGN

Hi, I’m Juan. Design is a form of care.

jc.

I’m driven to understand why some experiences feel natural while others make us hesitate. For over 12 years, I’ve explored that question through human behavior, design and business strategy.

Psychology, psychoanalysis and human factors shape the way I work. I notice the pause before a click, the hesitation in a flow and the moment when things begin to make sense.

I connect research, information architecture and frontend development to turn that understanding into products that respect people’s time and attention.
